content.text: `/usr/bin/time` isn't available. Let me use `ulimit -v` to enforce the 512 MiB address-space cap, which is what the verifier does:

arguments.command:
cd /work/tmp && for f in fib_max fib_mix; do
  ( ulimit -v 524288; time /work/submit/planb64 build $f.txt $f.idx ) 2>&1 | tr '\n' ' '; echo
  echo "$f rows=$(sed -n 2p $f.idx)"
done
head -3 fib_max.idx; tail -2 fib_max.idx; wc -l fib_max.idx fib_mix.idx; du -h fib_max.idx fib_mix.idx
